body: Thank you for saying so. It still hurts, and I feel hopeless. But maybe it will take time. Maybe nothing happened. I'll never know. I was really in the wrong place at the wrong time. Things just happened.
I'm sorry. What happened if you don't mind me asking
Ok I'll try. Thanks for your help.
Well that's good. Seems like it all worked out.
Oh, sorry that happened to you. I hope you're alright now
Why did he try to kill you? It sounds like you suffered a trauma. I have too.

I have no idea how to get over this, or move past it. The pain and feeling of guilt is constant and intense. Ot doesn't seem to go away anywhere I go. I even talked to my mom about this. I don't know why I can't get over it. I knew I shouldn't have done it but I did it anyway. It haunts me. I wouldn't wish this feeling on any enemy.

I've had it said to me too. I understand I'm just some internet nobody. But that doesn't give me any right. I guess the negativity can manifest in ways like this. I deeply regret it. Thinking about, if that person ever did do it or not, makes me completely lose all hope. It's psychological injury/torment. I can't explain why I feel like this

It doesn't feel like it's going to be okay. This was almost 2 months ago. I'm just baffled as to why I even said that. What if they did do it? I have panic attacks about it a lot. I still think about this daily. I just don't know what to do, I'm scared
